name: Duplicate invoice processing -> duplicate recording risk
rationale: A second recording of the same invoice is not a second purchase, and a second payment is a cash loss. The rule directs full-population duplicate analysis, documentary resolution of each suspected duplicate, and a test of the paid-invoice control.
